scripts.dev: npm run dev:shared:build && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @myenglishjourney/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @myenglishjourney/shared && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @myenglishjourney/shared && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @myenglishjourney/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
